supplemental_lifecycle_binding: The existing comparison manifest pins the ROOT peer guardian. ROOT explicitly agreed to verify this separately recorded processes.py helper hash at launch; no runner rewrite is required.

protocol.selection: First two distinct parents in original remaining schedule; both fresh arms use the same immutable268 boundary and inputs.
arms: one serial pair with4 encoder workers
one adaptive concurrent pair with up to2x4 encoder workers
protocol.timed_interval: Complete load, prepare and lossless pack until both futures return.
protocol.full_restore_and_array_scalar_provenance: After timing, exact comparison between arms.

substantive_lifecycle_review: Serial prefetch owns one future. The coordinator waits that exact future; only the next prefetch clears the completed previous future after result() succeeds and then creates the second. A producer never replaces the future.

Concurrent submissions claim distinct absent parents once, with joint phase/child admission. Futures are awaited without holding pool/governor locks; an optional deferral is reported and may fall back to serial supply.

Original encoder uses ProcessPoolExecutor with spawn in a context manager. Both normal return and exception unwinding wait for child completion; pending work is cancelled where possible. Adaptive credits remain through packing.

Arm close stops only its own producers, cancels queued work and joins workers; it does not signal production or unrelated processes. The outer ROOT guardian supplies the finite wall bound and exceptional owned-session drain if cooperative work stalls.
Read-only recursive sampler separates resource_tracker from encoder workers, recordsPID/start identities and current mainRSS/familyPSS, and limits encoder workers to4 or8 per arm.
Coordinator actual-waits each fresh arm, requires returncode0, then checks every trackedPID/start identity is absent before the next arm. It records actual wait and family-absence evidence.
Guardian process helper selects the original process session/group, checks project cwd andPID/start identity, uses pidfd signaling for owned cleanup and includes all session members in familyPSS.
limitations: One fixed-order serial-then-concurrent pair is subject to filesystem cache and order bias.
128GiB foreground headroom is reserved arithmetically; actual concurrent learned training contention is not measured.
Two-second family samples are sampled peaks, not continuous maxima; outer actual-session guard remains authoritative.
Success with fewer than8 observed simultaneous encoder workers or optional deferral is not evidence of an8-worker overlap peak.
Exact preparation/signature success does not establish learned-training speedup or authorize production deployment.
